title: Exquisite Saudi Arabian Filo Pastry Samosas
description: A winey, crumbly, show-off Saudi-Arabian dish featuring filo pastry and score-fat, vegan-friendly samosas filled with spiced potatoes and peas, perfect for a snack or light meal. This recipe combines traditional Middle Eastern flavors with a modern twist.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large pan, heat the score-fat over medium heat.
Add the onion, cumin, coriander, turmeric, salt, and black pepper to the pan and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the potatoes and peas to the pan and cook until the potatoes are tender.
Lay a sheet of filo pastry on a flat surface and brush with a little score-fat.
Place a tablespoon of the potato and pea mixture in the center of the pastry.
Fold the pastry into a triangle and press the edges together to seal.
Repeat with the remaining pastry and filling.
Place the samosas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and brush with a little score-fat.
Bake the samosas for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
